task: Submit draft expense report ER-2044 (employee Marta Okonjo, policy set POL-STD) in the Brightline Internal Expenses sandbox. Pull the draft's line items and the per-category daily limits from policy POL-STD, then submit ONLY the items whose amount is within its category limit. An item is out of policy only if its amount is STRICTLY GREATER than its category limit; an item exactly at the limit stays in. Do not modify or split amounts - simply omit the out-of-policy items. The submission requires the exact list of retained item ids and their exact summed total, rounded to 2 decimals. After submitting, request manager approval and report the approval id along with the submitted total.

POL-STD.note: An item is out of policy only if its amount is strictly greater than its category limit.

tools.name: get_report_items
tools.description: List every draft line item on an expense report: item_id, category and amount_usd.

tools.name: get_policy_limits
tools.description: Return the per-category daily spend limits for a policy set id.

tools.name: submit_report
tools.description: Submit an expense report with the item ids to include and their summed total. item_ids must be exactly the set of in-policy items (order does not matter) and total_usd must equal their exact sum rounded to 2 decimals. Returns a submission_id.

total_usd.description: exact sum of the included items, rounded to 2 decimals

require.error: Rejected: the submitted item set does not match the in-policy items for this report.
Rejected: total_usd does not equal the exact sum of the submitted items.

tools.name: request_approval
tools.description: Route a submitted report to the employee's manager for approval. Requires the submission_id returned by submit_report. Returns the approval id.
